description: This file provides CLI options and wrapper functions for calling a gateway service within a CLI tool. It defines types for options, functions to set command options, and an async function to invoke the gateway call with progress indication.

methods.name: gatewayCallOpts
methods.description: Configures command-line interface options for gateway calls.

methods.name: callGatewayCli
methods.description: Performs a gateway call with progress indication, using provided method name and options.

ctags.name: callGatewayCli
ctags.pattern: /^export const callGatewayCli = async (method: string, opts: GatewayRpcOpts, params?: unknown) =>$/
